 Game Thread | Mercyhurst at Notre Dame
 Notre Dame will open up its home schedule on Thursday night against Mercyhurst. 
 By Matt Freeman 
 November 5, 2026

 Photo by Keira Jones | ISD 
 Mercyhurst (0-1) vs. Notre Dame (1-0)  
 Date:  November 5
 Time:  7:00 PM ET 
 Where:  Purcell Pavilion | South Bend, Ind. 
 TV:  ACC Network Extra | Conor Clingen and Scott Martin
 Spread : Notre Dame -21.5
 Total : 139.5
 QUICK FACTS  
 - This will be the first meeting between the two programs. 
 - Notre Dame is ranked No. 73 by KenPom. 
 - The Irish 111-11 in season openers. 
 - Notre Dame will not play a true road game during its non-conference schedule this season. 
 - The Fighting Irish are eight wins away from 2,000 as a program.
